name: Hibiscus (karkade)
description: Ruby-red tart infusion, iced in Egyptian summers.

ayurveda.note: Sour yet classed cooling — an exception like amla.

unani.note: Served as a summer cooler across the Arab world.

effects.note: An umbrella review of 26 RCTs and nearly 1,800 participants found hibiscus tea dose-dependently lowers systolic and diastolic blood pressure compared with placebo. A cup or two a day, the amount most trials use, is ordinary tea-drinking. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
